title: Everything Can Made
description: Adds new repices to improve your experinces
body:
**This mod adds new repices to improve your experinces**

- This mod adds recipes to items that should have recipes in the game but do not have them.

- **Example**: This mod adds horse armor repices


- This mod adds some repices for **turn item**.

- **Example**: Anvil -> 15 Iron Ingot


- This mod adds repices to **duplicate item**:

- **Example**: 4 Redstone Block + 2 Flint + 2 Gunpowder + 1 Redstone = 9 gunpowder
